notes: Two failures. resetPassword validates req.body but then reads newPassword off the raw body, a field the schema never declares. Joi strips unknown keys from value and leaves req.body untouched, so the one value that changes the password is the one value never validated. A non-strict schema also accepts the extra property silently rather than rejecting the request. findAccount passes req.query.ownerId straight into a query; Express parses ?ownerId[$ne]= into an object, so the value reaching Mongoose is an operator rather than the string the code assumes, returning another tenant's account. Both are the same root cause: the value the handler uses is not the value that was checked.
